definition.OCE: sup_{a,y} E[(1+lambda) min(y+a(x)^T R,0)]-y; implemented as the exact weighted lower-tail mean
definition.density_dual: E[D]=1, 0<=D<=1+lambda; zero maximum is equivalent within the fixed kernel strategy class to a martingale density
definition.strategy: t0 is deterministic; t6 is a convex mixture of 64 fixed Gaussian state kernels with independent portfolio rows for every lambda
definition.sample: all 100,000 fixed paths are used for optimization and valuation

source_split_unused_for_fitting.weight_definition: exp(log(p/q)); physical estimates are N^-1 sum_r (p/q)_r f_r

reciprocal_fold_unused_for_fitting.definition: component-stratified reciprocal 50/50 folds; fold 0 trains on the first half and fold 1 trains on the second

portfolio_normalization.definition: calls with K<S are retained; calls with K>=S are replaced at entry by puts through P=C+K-S and dP=dC-dS; spot and option returns are divided by their positive entry prices
portfolio_normalization.cost: coordinatewise proportional cost after entry-value normalization

whitening.definition: xi_t=(x_t-m_t) Q_t Lambda_t^{-1/2}; m_t and covariance are estimated on training paths with physical p/q weights

kernel_basis.definition: physical-weighted MiniBatchKMeans centers in orthogonal t6 state; bandwidth is weighted within-center RMS distance

global_optimality_certificate.definition: For the fixed Gaussian basis the objective is concave in the long-short portfolio rows. A CVaR supergradient gives a global upper bound via the Frank-Wolfe gap on each nonnegative unit-L1 row.
